title: Business extensions
description: Manage grouped artifacts, verify before releasing, and track versions and execution eligibility.
loginHint: Use your current admin identity. Uploads, releases and other sensitive actions require an operation password and verification code.
otpHint: Each code can be used once. If you just used a code, wait for the next code.
recoveryOnce: Store these single-use recovery codes securely. They cannot be viewed again after closing.
sessionChanged: Release session changed. Reconnect to continue.
unknownResult: Outcome not confirmed. Check the original action receipt before creating another action.
fileLimit: File type, name, count or size does not meet the current policy.
resumeHint: Upload is incomplete. Resume with the same upload identifier and exact chunks.
uploadNeedsOriginal: The upload must still be resumable. Select the original files with identical names, sizes and contents.
permissionHint: Page access and release authorization are separate. Each sensitive action requires an operation password and verification code.
fileHint: SHA-256 is calculated before authorizing the exact file list. Compiled JAR output requires a separate release authorization.
releaseHint: Activation requires every target node to be ready. Failure preserves the eligible stable version. Canary and promotion retain the node set.
authorizeHint: Authorization binds the action, environment, group, revision and parameter digest.
resolveFirst: Resolve the uncertain action or finish the existing upload first.
workHint: Only your work with current entry permission is accessible. Uncertain results retain the original version and are never automatically retried.
reconcileWorkHint: A stable business adapter checks authoritative results and fences late execution. This does not rerun the plugin; missing or inconclusive adapters retain the current state.
requestRejected: Release service rejected the request ({code}). Check permissions, action context and current status.
unifiedEntryHint: Use your current admin identity. Uploads, releases and other sensitive actions require an operation password and verification code.
notConfigured: Release management is not configured. Ask an administrator to connect the service and bind your account.
serviceUnavailable: Release management is temporarily unavailable. Check the original receipt before retrying a submitted action.
identityUnbound: Your admin account has no release identity binding. Contact a release administrator.
identityDisabled: Your release identity binding is disabled. Contact a release administrator.
enrollmentRequired: You can view authorized information. Set up release verification before performing sensitive actions.
enrollmentHint: Use your enrollment ticket and operation password to set up an authenticator. No additional login is needed. Contact a release administrator if you lose your authenticator.
credentialUnknown: The one-time credential result is unknown. No new credential will be requested. Release operations must check and revoke any issued credential; reloading does not cancel the original request.
